# TechBasicCarpentry

**Tags:** `technology`

Foundation woodworking knowledge. Unlocks the carpentry bench, plank milling, and basic wood-component recipes.

> **Goal:** Root node of the carpentry tree; parallel to basic smithing for wood-primary builds
